data.name: Mahendrasinh
data.gender_notes: Mahendrasinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahendra is the name of Lord Shiva, the ruler of mountains. Sinh means lion, indicating power and courage. Thus, Mahendrasinh translates to ‘Lord of the Lion’ or ‘Lord of the Mountains’. The name Mahendrasinh carries the meaning “Lord of Mountains” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahendrasinh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of mountains and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by Lord Shiva, representing strength, courage, and divine power.
data.etymology: Mahendrasinh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Mountains.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahendrasinh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: In Hinduism, Lord Mahendra, also known as Mahadev or Shiva, is one of the primary deities, who represents fierce power, destruction, and regeneration. Mahendra becomes Mahendrasinh when he is invoked as the protector, blesser of rain, and the most powerful of all deities. The name Mahendrasinh carries the richness and mightiness of Lord Shiva, helping to connect the culture to its roots.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu cosmology, Lord Mahendra signifies divine strength, power, ruling harmoniously over various elements (waters, mountains, and divine beings). When invoked as Mahendrasinh, he embodies the divine power to overcome challenges and provide blessings, especially during times of need, drought, or distress. It signifies devotion to Lord Shiva, who protects and blesses his devotees, and the faith that no matter the circumstances, the divine is always there to help.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mahendrasinh: Lion of Mahendra (God Vishnu). Symbolizes strength, courage, and devotion to Vishnu, the preserver of the universe.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mahendrasinh Jadeja was a Jadeja Rajput king of Gujarat in the 11th century. The name Mahendrasinh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Mahendrasinh is a popular name among Jadeja Rajputs in Gujarat and Saurashtra regions.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mahendrasinh remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Rahul Mahendrasinh in Kathmandu, Nepal attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Mahendrasinh, which means "Lord of Mountains". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
